channel.title: Asha Yojana – Latest Updates
channel.description: Fresh, checked news on government schemes

item.title: Karnataka: drought relief of up to ₹5,000 per farmer, in two instalments
item.description: Karnataka says interim relief for drought-hit farmers is doubled from ₹2,500 to ₹5,000 per farmer; the second instalment is said to come 'after Diwali'.

item.title: Ladli Behna: 42nd instalment on 13 Nov 2026, ₹1,831.77 crore to about 1.25 crore women
item.description: As per PTI, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav released the 42nd Ladli Behna instalment from Pichhore (Shivpuri) on 13 November 2026.

item.title: Ayushman Bharat: proposal to reserve 112 packages for public hospitals (up from 23)
item.description: Reports say the NHA plans to reserve 89 more PM-JAY treatment packages for public hospitals only. This is a proposal, not an approval.

item.title: Life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) deadline for pensioners: 30 November
item.description: Reports say central and state government pensioners must submit the annual life certificate by 30 November 2026, or pension may pause from December.

item.title: Bihar brings PM Fasal Bima to Rabi 2026-27; applications till 15 January 2027
item.description: Bihar is adopting PMFBY from Rabi 2026-27; reports say applications run from 15 November 2026 to 15 January 2027.

item.title: Karnataka: ration card e-KYC deadline reported extended to 30 November
item.description: Reports say Karnataka moved the ration card e-KYC date from 10 to 30 November 2026; those who miss it may lose ration.

item.title: Stand-Up India scheme extended till 31 March 2031
item.description: On 11 November 2026 the Cabinet approved five more years of Stand-Up India for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.

item.title: PM Surya Ghar: over 50 lakh homes now have rooftop solar
item.description: Business Today, citing MNRE data, reports over 50 lakh installations; the target is 1 crore homes by March 2027.
